index_header.title: Index Header
index_header.description: The comments at the top of datamap.lua.

index.title: Index
index.description: datamap.lua as read: format, source, target and maps ({name, file, messages, when?} each - `when` the condition a map takes a message on, DMAPwhen.py). Null when it can't be read.

index_error.title: Index Error
index_error.description: Why datamap.lua can't be read, when it can't.

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.description: mapping.lua, which sends each message to the map that takes it.

mapping_state.title: Mapping State
mapping_state.description: What to do about mapping.lua in the node.

header.title: Header
header.description: The comments at the top of the map's file, kept when the Map view rewrites it.

definition.title: Definition
definition.description: The map's file as read: bundle, resources and rules (for HL7 v2: start, message, segments and rules). Null when it can't be read.

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: The map's file isn't in the node.

read_error.title: Read Error
read_error.description: Why the map's file can't be read.

code.title: Code
code.description: The map's generated Lua (maps/<name>.lua), or null when it can't be generated.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the map can't be turned into code, when it can't.

index.title: Index
index.description: The rule's position in the map's rules (0-based).

fn.title: Fn
fn.description: The generated function the rule's code sits in (mapper.mapPatient).

code.title: Code
code.description: The code the rule becomes, with any constant or local it needs.

code_state.title: Code State
code_state.description: What to do about maps/<name>.lua in the node.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: The rule it is about (0-based), if one.

target.title: Target
target.description: The target element it is about (Patient.name), if one.

filled.title: Filled
filled.description: For a map building CDA: what its code writes beyond the rules, by target row ({target, how: fixed, default or null, note}) - what a C-CDA template fixes, a default, or no information.

maps.title: Maps
maps.description: Each map in datamap.lua, keyed by its file.

path.title: Path
path.description: Where the module goes in the node (helpers/<name>.lua).

text.title: Text
text.description: The module's text, stamped with its checksum.

state.title: State
state.description: What to do about the node's copy.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.description: The helper modules the generated code requires.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: The rule it is about (0-based), if one.

target.title: Target
target.description: The target element it is about (Patient.name), if one.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Problems with the node's maps as a whole.
